description: This source file defines a utility function 'shapeAgentGroupedSeries' used for transforming raw aggregate records into a structured dataset suitable for visualization with Recharts. It groups data by agent and an optional secondary dimension (environment or cost_category), filling in missing categories with a default label to ensure consistent grouping for charting purposes.

methods.name: shapeAgentGroupedSeries(records, groupBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms raw records into a grouped dataset formatted for Recharts, with optional sorting and handling of unknown categories.
